ruling: ROUND 2 of the residue follow-up, rebuilt from GROUND TRUTH after independent review REQUEST CHANGES (https://github.com/HobbyIQ/HobbyIQ-V1/pull/2485#issuecomment-5863378351) found round 1's 267-sale, 88-entry list would have re-refused every entry identically to List 1 (0/268 pass the real namesAgree + stripVocabularyForDestination gate). This list is built two ways differently from round 1: (1) a narrow, corpus-measured Au/Autographs trailing marker was added to name-agreement.cjs (see that file's own comment and backend/tests/nameAgreementClosesNameShapeRefusals.test.ts), recovering some sales; (2) EVERY entry below is verified against the REAL gate live against Cosmos -- not an offline heuristic -- AND filtered to sales genuinely resident at fromId (sale.cardId === fromId), excluding sales that merely share a stale hobbyiqCardId pointer while already living at a different (usually correct) address; moving those would be either a no-op or a wrong-address write, not a fix for the stale-hobbyiqCardId defect they actually need (see this list's own census.dataQualityNote and the sidecar).
rulings: CF-SIBLING-CHECKLIST-DECIDES-THE-PRODUCT (unchanged from round 1 and the parent list).

Method (read-only, no writes performed by this investigation): drained live sales at all 153 List-2-refused fromIds (dual cross-partition + partition-scoped), computed each destination's REAL stripVocabularyForDestination() output, and ran namesAgree(sale.playerName ?? sale.title, toRow.playerName, {stripTrailingTokens}) against every one of 2,796 live sale docs found -- the EXACT comparison repoint-sales-by-list.cjs's gate 6 performs at APPLY time. 2,061 pass; of those, only 15 (across 10 fromIds) are genuinely resident at their bowman-chrome fromId (sale.cardId === fromId) rather than matched only through a stale hobbyiqCardId pointer while already living elsewhere.

The 1,969 (of 2,061) passing sales whose cardId already reads a DIFFERENT address (mostly the correct bowman toId) are the stale-hobbyiqCardId data-quality defect this task's original brief asked about directly (Allan Castro / Arjun Nimmala) -- confirmed here to affect roughly 2,000 sales, not 2. No lane in this repo patches hobbyiqCardId by list; this PR does not add one (out of scope), and none of those 1,969 sales are named in this repoint list.

census.method: Read-only.
